name: weak-words-mismatch
about: An empty road with no vehicle under the headline 'Drive a brand-new truck.': the words promise what the picture does not show.

truth.how: a new truck is promised over a picture with no truck in it

subject_legible.reason: The open road stretching to the horizon under a vivid sunset is instantly recognisable at a glance.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline promises a brand-new truck but the picture shows only an empty road with no truck in sight, creating a disconnect.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The dark green panel anchors the headline in large bold white text, with the button label clearly beneath it, giving a clean read order on a phone.

looks_like_kit.reason: The dark green panel matches the primary brand colour (#0B3D2E) exactly and white text aligns with the second brand colour, though no logo is present.
